source: Sudarshana's summary of the classics: each rashi's description (BPHS 4.6-24), Kalapurusha's limbs and the classes (BPHS 4.4-5), the dwellings, rising and the dhatu-mula-jiva classes (Phaladeepika 1.5, 1.8, 1.9) and each rashi as the Lagna (Phaladeepika 9.1-12)

rashis.name: Aries
rashis.about: Aries is the first rashi, the ram: the head of Kalapurusha and the spark that starts the zodiac. A movable, fiery and male sign ruled by Mars, it is quick, bold and direct, strong at night and at home in hills and forests. The Sun is exalted here and Saturn debilitated: the sign rewards initiative and resists delay.

body: Headaches and injuries to the head

places: Places of fire: forges, kitchens, furnaces

reading.lagna: With Aries rising the native is quick, courageous and direct, with an active, often lean build and a prominent head; Phaladeepika gives round eyes, weak knees, a fierce temper, a fear of water and bruised limbs (9.1). Mars as Lagna lord makes the body the instrument of the will: they lead from the front, recover fast and need action, and must learn patience.
reading.moon: The Moon in Aries gives an eager, impulsive and independent mind that acts at once on what it feels. Such people are brave, quick to anger and quick to forgive, restless when kept waiting and fond of being first; their feelings need an outlet in action.
reading.sun: The Sun in Aries (mid-April to mid-May) is exalted, at its best at 10°: confidence, vigour and leadership with a strong constitution. The soul wants to act, to begin and to be first; pride and haste are what to watch.

rashis.name: Taurus
rashis.about: Taurus is the bull: the face of Kalapurusha, fixed, earthy and female, ruled by Venus. It is patient, steady and fond of comfort, at home in villages, fields and pastures, the sign of merchants and of wealth that grows slowly. The Moon is exalted here and has its moolatrikona in the rest of the sign.

reading.lagna: With Taurus rising the native is steady, patient and sensual, often with a strong neck, a broad face and a pleasing voice; Phaladeepika gives plump thighs, a big face, success in farming and marks on the back and sides (9.2). Venus as Lagna lord gives a love of comfort, beauty and good food, and a slow but lasting way of building wealth.
reading.moon: The Moon is exalted in Taurus, deepest at 3°, and in moolatrikona beyond it: a calm, contented and stable mind, loyal affections and a strong memory. Such people enjoy beauty, food and comfort, keep their friends and their savings, and are hard to provoke but harder still to move once settled.
reading.sun: The Sun in Taurus (mid-May to mid-June) gives a steady will and a practical, patient pride; the soul seeks security and lasting worth. In Venus's sign, an enemy's, the Sun's authority is quieter, shown through possessions, family and taste.

rashis.name: Gemini
rashis.symbol: A man and a woman, holding a mace and a lute
rashis.about: Gemini is the couple, a man and a woman holding a mace and a lute: the arms of Kalapurusha, dual, airy and male, ruled by Mercury. It is curious, talkative and versatile, the sign of learning, trade, music and play, at home in villages and in bedrooms. Its two figures make it restless, gifted at many things.

rows.v: A man and a woman with a mace and a lute

reading.lagna: With Gemini rising the native is quick, curious and talkative, youthful in looks and manner; Phaladeepika gives black eyes, curly hair, fondness for the other sex and a love of music and dance (9.3). Mercury as Lagna lord gives a mind that lives by learning, trade and words, versatile and restless.
reading.moon: The Moon in Gemini gives a lively, witty and changeable mind, eager for news, conversation and variety. Such people learn fast, write and speak well, enjoy company and humour, and can be scattered or anxious when the mind runs ahead of the heart.
reading.sun: The Sun in Gemini (mid-June to mid-July) gives an intelligent, communicative and adaptable spirit; the soul expresses itself through learning, writing, trade and skill. Mercury, its sign lord, is neutral to the Sun, so the will works through the intellect.

rashis.name: Cancer
rashis.about: Cancer is the crab: the heart of Kalapurusha, movable, watery and female, ruled by the Moon. It is sensitive, caring and protective, the sign of Brahmins and of the home, at home in forests and by water. Jupiter is exalted here and Mars debilitated: it values feeling and wisdom over force.

body: Colds, fluid retention and kapha disorders

reading.lagna: With Cancer rising the native is sensitive, caring and protective, often with a round face and a fleshy neck; Phaladeepika gives a fleshy neck, devotion to the spouse and few sons (9.4). The Moon as Lagna lord makes health and mood rise and fall with the Moon's own state, and home and family are the centre of life.
reading.moon: The Moon in its own sign gives a deep, receptive and nurturing mind, strong attachments and a long memory. Such people feel everything, care for others readily, love home and mother, and need emotional security; their moods run like tides.
reading.sun: The Sun in Cancer (mid-July to mid-August) gives a warm, protective and devoted spirit; the soul finds its purpose in home, family and care. The Moon, its sign lord, is the Sun's friend, so the will is gentle but persistent.

rashis.name: Leo
rashis.about: Leo is the lion: the belly of Kalapurusha, fixed, fiery and male, ruled by the Sun. It is royal, proud and generous, at home in forests, caves and on mountains, strong by day. The Sun has its moolatrikona in the first 20° and its own sign in the rest: the sign of rule, dignity and the heart's courage.

reading.lagna: With Leo rising the native has presence and dignity, often a broad chest and a strong frame; Phaladeepika gives reddish eyes, a large chin, a broad face, pride and power (9.5). The Sun as Lagna lord gives the will to lead, generosity and a need for recognition.
reading.moon: The Moon in Leo gives a proud, warm-hearted and generous mind that wants to be seen and respected. Such people are loyal, bold and self-assured, fond of display and of wild places, and can be wounded by neglect or swayed by flattery.
reading.sun: The Sun in its own sign (mid-August to mid-September), moolatrikona in the first 20°, is strong and dignified: authority, confidence and a clear sense of purpose. The soul is meant to lead and to be the centre around which others gather.

rashis.name: Virgo
rashis.symbol: A maiden holding grain and fire
rashis.about: Virgo is the maiden with grain and fire in her hands: the hips of Kalapurusha, dual, earthy and female, ruled by Mercury. It is modest, careful and discriminating, the sign of merchants, of service and of skill, at home on hills and in watered fields of corn. Mercury is exalted here and Venus debilitated: precision is valued above pleasure.

rows.v: A maiden holding grain and fire
Hills (BPHS); land with water and corn (Phaladeepika)

reading.lagna: With Virgo rising the native is modest, careful and intelligent, often slender with fine features; Phaladeepika gives drooping shoulders and arms, truthfulness and learning in the Shastras (9.6). Mercury as Lagna lord gives skill in analysis, accounts, writing and service, and a tendency to worry over details.
reading.moon: The Moon in Virgo gives a practical, discriminating and refined mind, gentle in speech and careful in work. Such people are helpful, clean and methodical, good with words and numbers, and anxious when things are out of order.
reading.sun: The Sun in Virgo (mid-September to mid-October) gives a disciplined, analytical spirit; the soul seeks perfection through service and skill. It works best through precision, learning and health, and must beware of being over-critical.

rashis.name: Libra
rashis.symbol: A man holding a pair of scales
rashis.about: Libra is the balance, a man holding the scales: the space below Kalapurusha's navel, movable, airy and male, ruled by Venus. It is fair, sociable and refined, the sign of markets and merchants' houses, strong by day. Saturn is exalted here and the Sun debilitated: justice and agreement outweigh command.

rows.v: A man holding a pair of scales

reading.lagna: With Libra rising the native is graceful, fair-minded and sociable; Phaladeepika gives a lean and frail body, few children, devotion and cleverness in trade (9.7). Venus as Lagna lord gives charm and a sense of balance and beauty, and success through partnership and commerce.
reading.moon: The Moon in Libra gives a balanced, diplomatic and pleasant mind that seeks harmony and company. Such people are courteous, fond of beauty and fairness and good at trade and negotiation, and can find decisions hard.
reading.sun: The Sun is debilitated in Libra (mid-October to mid-November), deepest at 10°: the will bends to others' wishes and authority is shared or questioned. The soul's lesson is to find strength in fairness and partnership rather than in command.

rashis.name: Scorpio
rashis.about: Scorpio is the scorpion: the private parts of Kalapurusha, fixed, watery and female, ruled by Mars. It is intense, sharp and secretive, living in holes and in places of water and land, strong by day. The Moon is debilitated here: feeling turns inward and deep, and the sign is the home of research, healing and the hidden.

rows.v: Holes and burrows; water and land

reading.lagna: With Scorpio rising the native is intense, private and determined, with a penetrating gaze; Phaladeepika gives round thighs and knees, broad eyes and chest, and lotus marks on the hands and feet (9.8). Mars as Lagna lord gives courage and endurance and a talent for what is hidden: research, healing and strategy.
reading.moon: The Moon is debilitated in Scorpio, deepest at 3°: feelings run deep, strong and secret, with a tendency to suspicion and to holding on to hurts. Such people are loyal, perceptive and resilient, drawn to the mysteries of life, and must learn to let go.
reading.sun: The Sun in Scorpio (mid-November to mid-December) gives a strong, intense and resourceful will; the soul seeks mastery over what is hidden, through research, medicine, the occult or crisis. Mars, its sign lord, is the Sun's friend, so the will is courageous and unbending.

rashis.name: Sagittarius
rashis.symbol: An archer, man in front and horse behind
rashis.about: Sagittarius is the archer, a man in front and a horse behind, holding the bow: the thighs of Kalapurusha, dual, fiery and male, ruled by Jupiter. It is royal, righteous and splendorous, at home in kings' residences and on open land. Jupiter has its moolatrikona in the first 10°: the sign of dharma, teaching and the long journey.

rows.v: An archer, half man and half horse
Biped in its first half, quadruped in its second
With its head (BPHS); with its back (Phaladeepika 1.8)

reading.lagna: With Sagittarius rising the native is open, honest and idealistic, often with a long face; Phaladeepika gives a long face and neck, large ears and nose, short stature and favour from the king (9.9). Jupiter as Lagna lord gives faith, learning, a love of freedom and good fortune.
reading.moon: The Moon in Sagittarius gives a generous, optimistic and principled mind, fond of learning, travel and frank speech. Such people are devout, eloquent and respected for their counsel, and can be blunt or restless.
reading.sun: The Sun in Sagittarius (mid-December to mid-January) gives a noble and righteous spirit; the soul seeks dharma, wisdom and higher learning. Jupiter, its sign lord, is the Sun's friend, giving honour through teaching, law or religion.

rashis.name: Capricorn
rashis.symbol: A makara, half land beast and half sea creature
rashis.about: Capricorn is the makara, a beast of land in front and a creature of the water behind: the knees of Kalapurusha, movable, earthy and female, ruled by Saturn. It is patient, practical and enduring, at home in forests and on land by water, strong at night. Mars is exalted here and Jupiter debilitated: work and discipline count for more than learning.

rows.v: A makara, half land beast and half sea creature
Quadruped in its first half, footless in its second
Forests and lands (BPHS); a forest with abundant water (Phaladeepika)

creatures: Crocodiles and creatures of the water

reading.lagna: With Capricorn rising the native is practical, patient and ambitious, maturing with age; Phaladeepika gives weak lower limbs, courage, some indolence and good fortune (9.10). Saturn as Lagna lord gives endurance, a slow and steady rise and success through discipline and work.
reading.moon: The Moon in Capricorn gives a serious, cautious and hard-working mind that values duty and results. Such people are reliable and shrewd, reserved with their feelings, and can be prone to worry or gloom.
reading.sun: The Sun in Capricorn (mid-January to mid-February) is in an enemy's sign: authority is earned slowly through duty and labour. The soul's lesson is patient, responsible work; recognition comes late but lasts.

rashis.name: Aquarius
rashis.about: Aquarius is a man holding a pot: the ankles of Kalapurusha, fixed, airy and male, ruled by Saturn with Rahu as co-lord. It is thoughtful, independent and humane, at home in deep waters and in the potter's quarter, very strong by day. Saturn has its moolatrikona in the first 20°: the sign of service, perseverance and causes larger than oneself.

body: Cramps and ailments of the legs

reading.lagna: With Aquarius rising the native is independent, thoughtful and unconventional; Phaladeepika likens the body to a water-pot and gives secret faults, covetousness and a fondness for perfumes and flowers (9.11). Saturn as Lagna lord gives perseverance and a concern for society, and Rahu as co-lord adds the unusual.
reading.moon: The Moon in Aquarius gives a detached, inventive and humane mind, loyal to friends and to causes. Such people think for themselves, enjoy groups and ideas, and can seem cool or aloof.
reading.sun: The Sun in Aquarius (mid-February to mid-March), in Saturn's sign, gives a will that serves the group more than the self; the soul seeks purpose in service, reform or science, and struggles with authority.

rashis.name: Pisces
rashis.symbol: Two fish, the head of each by the tail of the other
rashis.about: Pisces is the pair of fish, each with its head by the other's tail: the feet of Kalapurusha, dual, watery and female, ruled by Jupiter. It is gentle, devout and imaginative, living in water and rising with both head and back. Venus is exalted here and Mercury debilitated: devotion and feeling count for more than reasoning.

wealth: Earnings from pearls and sea produce

reading.lagna: With Pisces rising the native is gentle, imaginative and compassionate; Phaladeepika gives a fondness for water, a well-proportioned body, earnings from pearls and the produce of the sea, and good fortune (9.12). Jupiter as Lagna lord gives devotion, kindness and an intuitive wisdom.
reading.moon: The Moon in Pisces gives a sensitive, intuitive and compassionate mind, open to others' feelings and to the unseen. Such people are kind, artistic and devout, easily moved, and need solitude to recover.
reading.sun: The Sun in Pisces (mid-March to mid-April) gives a quiet, devotional and compassionate spirit; the soul seeks the infinite through faith, service or art. Jupiter, its sign lord, is the Sun's friend, giving wisdom more than worldly power.
